npcs.name: Dr. Maddis Li
npcs.description: Dr. Maddis Li is a brilliant Vautaces Dragonborn power theorist with little patience for uniforms, slogans, or anyone who confuses engineering with faith. She studies reactors, leyline frames, ichor-fed generators, and containment systems because stable power keeps cities alive, even when every faction wants to weaponize her work. Maddis can be abrasive and politically slippery, but she is driven by results, not cruelty, and she despises seeing good science chained to bad orders.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Moltharok is a City in Zharvokh, under Military Regency, with severe danger, Marshes and swamps, Farming, Mountain range terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Vautaces Dragonborn reads through the Dragonborn entry of the race compendium, within Draconic and Reptilian Races, marked by Valkhamesh. Dragonborn are draconic humanoids born of ancient dragon lineage, elemental force, dynastic memory, and divine sovereignty. rumors: Maddis once walked out of a military project mid-sentence after realizing the safety report had been rewritten.
Her calculations appear in half the Directorate's restricted engines, though she denies approving their use.
plotHooks: Maddis asks the party to steal her own reactor notes before Glasswell Institute turns them into a prison system.
A failing town generator can be saved only if the party convinces Maddis to trust people she has already abandoned once.
